findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed milk in walk in cooler to be less than 6 inches above floor. Discussed with PIC, milk will be placed in a location that is 6 inches above ground, ensure all food items are kept 6 inches above flooring
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: Observed icicle forming in back walk in freezer. Discussed with PIC, walk in freezer will be serviced. Ensure walk in freezer unit is working to th manufactures standards.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Observed no sanitizer solution to be set up upon inspection. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer bucket was made and tested at 200 ppm. Ensure sanitizer solution is set up during all hours of operation. 

4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the produce packing station to be soiled with food debris and a dead fly. Discussed with PIC, ensure all non-food contact surfaces are cleaned at frequency that prevents food accumulation. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
Observed the milk walk in cooler to have no working lightbulb. Discussed with PIC, lightbulb was replaced and is now in operation. Ensure walk in cooler has proper lighting to meet the manufacturers standards. 

6-303.11: The light intensity shall be at least a certain lux and present in certain areas.
